# Rust export fixtures

`small.db` and `dictionary.db` are generated by the repository's Rust `export`
function via `typescript/scripts/fixtures`. Its integrity checks compare every
source row, column declaration, index, and version before saving the export.
No native SQLite addon is used by the TypeScript tests.

Regenerate from the repository root (Rust and a C++14 compiler required):

```sh
cargo run --locked --manifest-path typescript/scripts/fixtures/Cargo.toml -- typescript/test/fixtures
```

The helper uses its own lockfile and does not build the main crate's benchmark
dependencies. Source databases are temporary and removed after successful export.
The deterministic data consists of 80 or 24000 telemetry rows, 96-byte xorshift
payloads, `x = id / 8`, `label = 'car ' + (id % 40)`, and user_version 17.
The generator creates an index on label. `small.db` includes raw and dictionary-free
compressed pages. `dictionary.db` also includes trained-dictionary pages; the suite
reads the whole table and queries the index to exercise these page types.
The point lookup test checks that HTTP bytes transferred stay below a quarter of the file.
Dictionary training/compression library versions may change binary bytes when regenerated;
the format and SQL results must remain compatible.

Fixtures contain synthetic data only and are licensed under the repository's MIT license.
